description.title: פיצוי מוסכם במקרה של אי-גילוי
description.summary: This table details agreed compensation amounts the policy owner must pay the insurer due to incomplete or dishonest responses to underwriting questions. It outlines sums related to injury compensation, both for the policy owner and other injured parties.
description.embed_passage: This table details agreed compensation amounts the policy owner must pay the insurer due to incomplete or dishonest responses to underwriting questions. It outlines sums related to injury compensation, both for the policy owner and other injured parties. The compensation is linked to the Compensation Law, specifically paragraph 4(a)(3) regarding non-pecuniary damages. For example, if the policy owner sustains injury, they will pay the insurer an amount equal to the compensation due for non-pecuniary damages, but not exceeding NIS 10,000. The table also addresses compensation for injured parties who are not the policy owner, with a maximum total compensation of NIS 10,000.
notable_values: Compensation for policy owner injury: up to ₪10,000

sketch:
9.3 In the event that the policy owner responds to an underwriting question with a response which was not full and honest at the time same was given and due to the response insurance fees were set which were lower than the insurance fees which would have been set had the policy owner provided a full and honest response, or that the insurer agreed to enter into the insurance contract due to the response as aforementioned, although tit would not have done so had a full and honest response been given -and an insured event occurs prior to the insurance contract having been cancelled -the following provisions shall apply:
9.3.1 In the event that the policy owner sustains injury as a result of an insured event, the policy owner shall pay the insurer agreed compensation, in a sum equal to the compensation due to the policy owner in regard to nonpecuniary damages in accordance with paragraph 4(a)(3) of the Compensation Law, however, no more than NIS 10,000.
9.3.2 Without derogating from whatsoever appearing in paragraph 9.3.1, the policy owner shall pay the insurer agreed compensation in a sum of NIS 2,500 in respect of each injured person who is not the policy owner -who is compensated by the insurer due to the insured event -however, no more than half the compensation sum paid to each injured person as aforementioned, provided that the inclusive agreed compensation sum according to this paragraph shall not exceed NIS 10,000.
